reviewType: fresh bounded independent affected-only PIXEL review

bindingVerification.method: Read-only SHA256 verification of the receipt against the supplied expected hash, each of exactly four receipt.headers[].screenshot files, each bound sourceHtml file, and the prior body report against receipt.failure. PNG signature and IHDR dimensions were read without decoding pixels and match the receipt viewport width and headerScreenshotHeight. No source HTML content review was performed.

headers.observation: Actual original-resolution pixels show one italic p and one italic n in the title, with no raw dollar delimiters or duplicated glyphs. The complete title fits on one line, with unclipped glyphs and room to its right. The printed-page 264 line sits separately below the title; the descending p remains clear of that line. No title overlap with neighboring content is visible within this heading-only crop.

Actual original-resolution pixels show single italic p/n glyphs, no raw dollar delimiters, and the complete exercise-title suffix after its separator. The title and suffix fit on one line without clipping or collisions. The printed-page 264 line is clearly below and separate from the heading. No title overlap with neighboring content is visible within this heading-only crop.

Actual original-resolution pixels show single italic p/n glyphs on the first title line and no raw dollar delimiters. The complete title wraps onto two lines within both mobile margins; neither glyphs nor the final title text are clipped. The two title lines do not collide. The printed-page 264 line remains below the second title line with visible separation. No title overlap with neighboring content is visible within this heading-only crop.

Actual original-resolution pixels show single italic p/n glyphs and no raw dollar delimiters. The title wraps onto two lines, with the separator and complete exercise suffix fitting on the second line. Both lines stay inside the mobile margins with no clipping, glyph collision, or interline overlap. The printed-page 264 line is separately visible below the second line. No title overlap with neighboring content is visible within this heading-only crop.

findings.title: Heading exposes raw inline-math delimiters
findings.observation: All four newly supplied heading screenshots visibly render single italic p/n glyphs without literal dollar delimiters. Desktop titles fit on one line; mobile titles wrap cleanly onto two lines. No clipping or overlap with the printed-page line or neighboring visible content was observed.
findings.scope: Only the repaired offline text/exercises headings at viewport widths 1440 and 390. No claim about the live application.

reusedBodyReport.reuseBasis: The hash-bound prior report records PASS observations for body text, body formulas, emphasis, section breaks, figure labels and caption placement. Its sole finding is the heading defect PIXEL-1. Those existing body observations are reused as instructed, not freshly established by this review.
reusedBodyReport.receiptChangeDeclaration: receipt.htmlChanges declares onlyChangedElement h1 for both surfaces; this declaration is reused, not independently source-reviewed.

scope.included: Independent actual-pixel review of exactly the four receipt.headers[].screenshot heading crops, limited to rendered p/n, absence of raw dollar delimiters, title fitting/wrapping and clearance from the printed-page line and visible neighboring content.
scope.excluded: Original textbook images, body tiles, other images, body/SCI/figure/source review, rerendering, browser use, pipelines, tests, DB operations, git operations, promotion, and index/meter changes.
scope.acceptanceLimit: Heading-fix PIXEL evidence only; not application acceptance, publication, promotion or formal handoff.
